data.exact_reserve_text: A surplus run-off deviation of GBP 1.3 million was experienced in 2014 (2013: GBP 6.4 million surplus). This was made up of a surplus on the prior year claims provisions of GBP 2.0 million on direct business (2013: GBP 3.4 million surplus) and a GBP 0.7 million deficit on reinsurance accepted business (2013: GBP 3.0 million surplus). The direct improvements primarily arose from the fire and other damage to property books and the reinsurance accepted deteriorations primarily arose from a deterioration on the casualty book although this was partly offset by a surplus on the property book (2013: the direct and reinsurance accepted surpluses primarily arose from the fire and other damage to property books).

prior_year_events.impact_description: contributed to the 2013 year of account loss, indicating adverse development

named_events.loss_description: one large claim of note relating to the 2013 year of account

data.standardized_narrative: The syndicate experienced a net prior year reserve release of GBP 1.3 million in 2014. This was driven by a GBP 2.0 million surplus on direct business, primarily from the Fire and other damage to property books due to favorable claims development. This was partially offset by a GBP 0.7 million deficit on reinsurance accepted business, mainly from the Casualty book, although this was mitigated by a surplus on the Property book. The prior year development affected the 2012 and 2013 underwriting years.
